content: CWS is a task for Chinese natural language process to delimit word boundary. BIBREF0 for the first time formulize CWS as a sequence labeling task. BIBREF3 show that different character tag sets can make essential impact for CWS. BIBREF2 use CRFs as a model for CWS, achieving new state-of-the-art. Works of statistical CWS has built the basis for neural CWS.
